Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Determination of Crimes in the Implementation of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

Supreme People's Court

Provisions on the Determination of Crimes

in the Implementation of the Criminal Law

of the People's Republic of China

Fa Shi [1997] No. 9

(Adopted at the 951st Session of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 9, 1997, and effective as of December 16, 1997)

For the purpose of correctly understanding and implementing the revised Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China adopted at the Fifth Session of the Eighth National People's Congress, and to unify the determination of crimes, the following provisions are made in accordance with the revised Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China regarding the crimes in the Specific Provisions:
